description: Use this when you want the deliveries stored for you (a feed without a webhook, or one whose webhook failed): lists unacknowledged items, or one item with item_id (include_acked=true for all). Items are kept 72 hours. Read-only; hide handled items with ack_feed_mailbox_item. Example: get_feed_mailbox(feed_id="...")

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_...), returned once by buy_credits or create_feed. Send it on every later feed or credit call.

feed_id.description: Optional. Only items from this feed.

name: get_feed_mailbox
title: Feed mailbox
